units.source_text: 堀木起身，一邊穿上衣一邊說道，「我要出門了，真不好意思啊。」

en.t: Horiki stood up and, putting on his jacket, said, "I have to go out now. I am really sorry."

units.source_text: 這時，正好有一位女客人來找堀木，我的命運也隨之轉變。

en.t: Just then, a female visitor happened to come looking for Horiki, and my fate changed with that.

units.source_text: 堀木突然變得活力四射，說：「啊，真的抱歉。

en.t: Horiki suddenly became full of energy and said, "Ah, I am truly sorry.
I was just thinking of going to see you.

units.source_text: 不料卻來了一位不速之客。

en.t: But then an unexpected guest showed up.

units.source_text: 不過，沒關係的，請，請進吧。」

en.t: Still, it is all right. Please, please come in."

units.source_text: 我抽出自己坐的坐墊，翻個面遞過去，

en.t: I pulled out the cushion I had been sitting on, turned it over, and handed it to him,

units.source_text: 他一把奪過，又翻了個面，然後請女客人就座。

en.t: but he snatched it away, turned it over again, and offered it to the woman as a seat.

units.source_text: 房間裡除了堀木的坐墊外，就只剩下這個坐墊供客人使用了。

en.t: Aside from Horiki's own cushion, this was the only cushion in the room for a guest to use.
The woman was thin and tall.

units.source_text: 她將坐墊擺在一旁，在門口附近坐了下來。

en.t: She set the cushion aside and sat down near the doorway.
